_meta.source: TCVN 11823-3:2017 §10.5.1 + Terzaghi seepage approximation for sheet piles
_meta.rule: All pressures in kN/m2, elevations in m (positive upward), gamma_w = 9.81 kN/m3

constants.note: Use 10.0 kN/m3 as conservative approximation when stated in project spec

arrows.note: scale_units=xy scale=1 angles=xy — same convention as earth_pressure.py

hydrostatic.condition: No flow, equal water levels or impermeable base

net_water_pressure.sign: Positive = net pressure toward front (excavation) side = drives pile toward front
net_water_pressure.resultant_formula: U = integral(delta_p_w * dz) along pile length [kN/m]

seepage_simplified.description: Terzaghi simplified flow net for sheet pile with unequal water levels
seepage_simplified.seepage_path_length: L_seep = 2 * d  (d = embedment below excavation level)
seepage_simplified.back_side_correction: p_back(z) = gamma_w * max(0, water_elev_back - elev - delta_h/2 * (z_from_back_wt / d))
seepage_simplified.front_side_correction: p_front(z) = gamma_w * max(0, water_elev_front - elev + delta_h/2 * (z_from_exc / d))
seepage_simplified.note: Only valid below excavation level. Above excavation: hydrostatic applies.
seepage_simplified.ref: Terzaghi (1943) — approximation, not substitute for flow net

uplift_pressure.description: Net upward water force on pile cross-section at any elevation
uplift_pressure.formula: F_uplift = p_front - p_back  (positive = upward = reduces pile bearing capacity)
uplift_pressure.note: Relevant for pile bearing; not the same as net lateral water pressure

effective_stress_rule.below_water_table_back: sigma_v_eff = gamma_moist * z_dry + gamma_sub * z_wet  (downward seepage: +i*gamma_w*z_wet)
effective_stress_rule.below_water_table_front: sigma_v_eff = gamma_moist * z_dry + gamma_sub * z_wet  (upward seepage: -i*gamma_w*z_wet)

sign_convention.elevation: positive upward, datum = project datum (pile top_elev = +2.7 m)

scenarios.label: Hydrostatic — Equal Water Levels
scenarios.note: No net lateral water force. Still affects effective stress.

scenarios.label: Hydrostatic — Unequal Water Levels (conservative)
scenarios.net_p: gamma_w * (water_elev_back - water_elev_front) at any elev below both WLs
scenarios.note: Conservative: ignores head dissipation along seepage path

scenarios.label: Seepage — Terzaghi Simplified
scenarios.condition: water_elev_back > water_elev_front, flow under pile tip
scenarios.note: Reduces net pressure compared to conservative hydrostatic; requires embedment depth d
